subject: Islanded cluster provenance & activation timeline
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@atlanticgrid.com>, Atlantic Grid Ops <ops@atlanticgrid.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Islanded cluster provenance & activation timeline

Jordan / Ops team —

Thanks for the call today. Attached is a draft activation timeline and the signed manifest bundle we intend to courier to your depot. High-level flow below:

1) Pre-shipment: final artifact signing (Redwood KMS) + manifest packaging (manifest-signatures.tar.gz attached).
2) Courier window: pick-up on Mon 2028-02-27, transit ETA 48–72 hrs to your site.
3) On-site: operator handback ceremony (90-minute window) — operator signs acceptance form and we capture operator key fingerprints.
4) Activation window: scheduled cutover 2028-03-04 02:00–04:00 UTC (low-traffic).
5) Post-activation: offline verification run + integrity attestations uploaded to our control plane (via sealed-bundle report).

Open questions for you:
- Are you able to accept a single physical package (manifest + signed images) or do you prefer split packages per-rack?
- Do you require Redwood to perform the on-site signing ceremony (we can send an operations engineer) or do you want the internal operator to complete the acceptance and send signed receipts back to us?

I've attached activation_timeline.xlsx and manifest-signatures.tar.gz for your review. Please confirm by EOD 2028-02-16 so we can lock courier windows.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: activation_timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet), manifest-signatures.tar.gz (tarball)

From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@atlanticgrid.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Atlantic Grid Ops <ops@atlanticgrid.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-15T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Islanded cluster provenance & activation timeline

Karthik —

Thanks for the plan and the attachments. A couple quick items from our side:

- We'll need the manifest split into two packages (control plane images separate from runtime images) for chain-of-custody reasons. Can you repack and re-sign accordingly?
- For the operator handback: we prefer to perform the acceptance locally with our operator present; please provide a checklist and the expected key fingerprint format so we can validate before the ceremony.
- Security constraint: we cannot accept courier arrival later than 2028-02-29 due to maintenance on the receiving dock. Can you shift pickup earlier if possible?

If Redwood can confirm a pick-up on 2028-02-25 and provide the checklist, we'll sign off. Also CC'ing our operations manager to coordinate the operator window.

Best,
Jordan Price
Head of Infrastructure Operations
Atlantic Grid

---
Jordan.Price@atlanticgrid.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@atlanticgrid.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-20T14:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Islanded cluster provenance & activation timeline

Jordan —

Thanks — we can do split packaging and will produce two signed tarballs (control-plane-signatures.tar.gz and runtime-signatures.tar.gz). Attached is our offline verification checklist (offline_verification_checklist.pdf) which mirrors the acceptance steps the operator will run:

- Verify manifest HMAC (SHA-256) against manifest header.
- Validate signature chain: Redwood root -> intermediate ops key -> bundle signature.
- Confirm firmware allowances against approved list (checked offline).
- Import expected key fingerprints into the sterile terminal and confirm match.
- Perform offline start-up verification (tokenless smoke test) per checklist.

On the pickup date: we can do 2028-02-25 pickup in the morning PST. Courier will be a bonded vendor with tamper-evident seals; we will provide seal IDs in the courier manifest.

One more item: for the operator handback, please confirm the name and GPG key id of the local operator who will sign acceptance. We will provide a standardized acceptance form for signatures.

Mina Haddad
Manager, Deployment Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: offline_verification_checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@atlanticgrid.com>
Date: 2028-02-27T11:55:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Islanded cluster provenance & activation timeline

Looping in some technical clarifications on key rotation and emergency rollback to make sure the activation window is safe:

- Key rotation: we will rotate the bundle signing key on our side after shipment but before activation window. Redundancy: the operator will be provided a verification file containing both pre-rotation and post-rotation public keys; the acceptance script checks either fingerprint against the manifest.
- Emergency rollback trigger: operator can initiate rollback if the offline smoke test fails at step 3 (node health). Rollback artifacts are included in runtime-signatures.tar.gz and are encrypted with a separate courier passphrase which we will release only after operator logs acceptance failures.
- Audit trail: we will append a signed attestation to the manifest and push a cryptographic receipt into the Redwood control plane when the on-site team confirms operator acceptance (receipt will be uploaded by us, not over your network).

I've attached a key-rotation-matrix.csv that maps key IDs to expected fingerprints for the two signing epochs. Please verify and confirm acceptance of the emergency rollback criteria so we can finalize the cutover plan.

Jonas Weber
Principal Reliability Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: key-rotation-matrix.csv (csv)

Jordan / Ops team —

Great — thanks for the quick turn. Summary and next steps:

1) Pickup confirmed: 2028-02-25 AM (bonded courier). We'll send courier manifest (seal IDs + tracking) 24 hrs before pickup.
2) Packaging: producing control-plane-signatures.tar.gz and runtime-signatures.tar.gz; re-signed and attached to the final manifest.
3) Operator checklist: offline_verification_checklist.pdf is the canonical checklist; operator should provide GPG key ID in reply.
4) Key rotation: see attached key-rotation-matrix.csv — both pre/post fingerprints included.
5) Emergency rollback: rollback artifacts are encrypted; passphrase release is gated on logged acceptance failure.

Attachments included with this message: final_manifest_signed.json (this contains the re-packed manifest pointers and signature indexes). Please reply with: operator name + GPG key ID and confirmation of acceptance window (we have cutover 2028-03-04 02:00–04:00 UTC). Once we have that, I'll schedule the operations engineer to be available by phone during the handback and will create JIRA INF-1983 to track site acceptance.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth activation.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: final_manifest_signed.json (json)
